text.title: Competitive Intelligence Methods Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on how many lawful sources could supply the signal asked for, whether collection repeats on a cadence, and whether the candidate methods touch human sources or automation — to full application, a legality-first or robots-first path, or skip when there is no method choice to make.

decision-tree.root-question: How many lawful methods could supply the signal that was actually asked for, and does collection repeat on a cadence?

branch.when: exactly one lawful source exists for the signal — a published filing, a single changelog, one registry

conclusion.verdict: skip; collect it directly — a selection artefact listing one candidate documents a decision nobody made and is later read as evidence that alternatives were weighed

branch.when: the programme has no recurring cadence; this is a one-shot look at who the competitors are

conclusion.verdict: skip; run competitor-analysis instead — method selection, raw-capture paths and cadence only pay back across repeated cycles

branch.when: several candidate methods exist and collection repeats on a declared cadence
branch.question: Do the candidate methods reach human sources or past an authentication gate, involve automated collection against public surfaces, or stay entirely manual and public?

branch.when: the plan leans on human sources (competitor sales calls, ex-employee interviews, customer probes) or on access past a login (trial signups under a false company, scraping behind authentication)

conclusion.verdict: apply, starting with the legality pass: any method requiring a false identity or credentialed access goes to `methods_rejected` with its reason before a plan is written, and if nothing lawful survives, the skip record with the legal reason is the artefact

branch.when: all candidates are public-surface but at least one is automated — a scraper, diff bot or API poller

conclusion.verdict: apply; each automated row declares the robots.txt user-agent group it obeys and its request rate, or is replaced by the manual variant of the same method before the plan is accepted

branch.when: all candidates are public-surface and collected manually

conclusion.verdict: apply the full methodology; derive methods from `signal_needed` rather than from the collectors already owned, give every selected method a false-signal guard, and name a cadence, one human owner and a raw-capture path per row
